Same transaction ID can be used for multiple transactions. Guideline for UNDERGRADUATE ADMISSIONS Pre-Admission Entry Test 1. Register yourself in Admission Web Portal at NED University Website “www.neduet.edu.pk/admission” by entering your Name (as per Matriculation or equivalent certificate), Father’s name (as per Matriculation or equivalent certificate), e-Mail address (please ensure you have entered your active email address) and Date of Birth (as per Matriculation or equivalent certificate). 2. You will receive User ID and Password through email on the email provided in step 1. 3. Please log-in to Admission Web Portal using your user ID and Password provided through email. 4. Select the following: i. Board from where you passed HSC or equivalent examination. ii. Your HSC Examination group i.e. Pre-Engineering or Pre-Medical, etc. iii. Your Domicile. iv. Select category(ies) for which you are eligible to apply. v. Click on save and move to NEXT step. 5. Go to the subsequent pages of Online Admission Web Portal and complete all required information. 6. Please make sure to upload an acceptable photograph of candidate as mentioned in “Guideline for the Online Application-Photograph”. 7. 8. Go to the designated banks’ branch as mentioned on the Transaction Slip. 9. Submit the fees as mentioned on the Transaction Slip. 10. Admit card will be available at the admission portal after confirmation of the fee submission by the bank (within 3 to 5 working days). Delay in issuance of admit card may be due to invalid/inappropriate photograph or non-confirmation of fee payment through online by the bank. In that case please write your query on Admission Helpdesk. 11. Don’t forget to bring the print out of your Pre-Admission Entry Test Admit Card at the day of Entry Test (mentioned in the schedule on admission website). After Qualifying the Pre-Entry Admission Test 12. Merit lists of different categories will be displayed on NED Website (www.neduet.edu.pk/admission) as per Admission Schedule. 13. If you are called in the Merit List, follow the schedule and perform the following activities. Note If your name appears in the Merit Lists 14. Print the filled Application Form from the Admission Web Portal. 15. Sign the Application Form. Also get your form duly signed by your Parents / Guardian and Oath Commissioner. 16. Signed Admission form, along with all documents mentioned in Document Checklist, are to be submitted at the time of interview as mentioned in the Admission Schedule on Admission Website. 17. Candidate will be called for Pre-Admission Interview as per Admission Schedule.  For any further queries, please read the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) available on NED UET website.  For further queries please visit Helpdesk on your Admission Portal.  For admission in category for those having disability (excluding the disability of deadness, dumbness and blindness) and passed HSC (Pre-Engineering/Computer Science) part I and II (as the case may be), from any Board of Intermediate of Education situated in province of Sindh and having certificate of disability from Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPD), Government of Sindh. Further the candidate is required to appear before the Medical Board at the University.  For admission in the category reserved for Diploma of Associate Engineer (DAE), the applicant must pass the qualifying examination from institution recognized by Sindh Board of Technical Education (SBTE), with minimum 60%, during last three years.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) UNDERGRADUATE ADMISSIONS Admission form Q1. How can I get Admission Form? A. Application for the Undergraduate Admissions is available at Admission Web Portal www.neduet.edu.pk/admission. Q2. Who is eligible to apply for Admission? A. An applicant who is appearing in HSC-II or Equivalent Examination in 2026 and have passed his/her previous examination. An applicant who has passed HSC-II or Equivalent Examination in 2025, 2024 or 2023. Q3. What is the minimum percentage in HSC or Equivalent Examinations required for the admission to undergraduate programmes? A. For all Bachelors of Engineering Programmes, Bachelor of Architecture and BS (Computer Science) minimum 60% in HSC or Equivalent Examinations is required but candidates who have secured at least 57% in HSC-1 or Equivalent Examinations (O-Levels for Cambridge Examination Board) are eligible to apply. However, they must maintain a minimum of 60% in their HSC/Equivalent examinations to confirm their admission. For all BS Programmes except BS (Computer Science) minimum 50% in HSC or Equivalent Examinations is required. Please see Chapter-4 of the Undergraduate Prospectus for details. Q4. What is the merit criteria for merit for admission in undergraduate programmes? A. The overall merit in respect of candidates from admission shall be determined based on Merit Score (MS) to be calculated as: MS = 40% (HSC Part I/ O-level Marks/ Equivalent Examinations) * + 60% (NED Entry Test Marks) * For candidates already completed HSC/A-level/Equivalent examinations will be dealt as per policy. Q5. How should I take an additional Non-Credit (NC) course based on my admitted program and my intermediate/equivalent group? A. The University will offer an additional NC course in First year, Fall semester, and students must qualify this course. The University will charge an additional fee for this NC course. Q6. I have been appearing in additional mathematics/improvement examinations, which marks/year I have to enter in the admission form? A. You have to enter the HSC/Equivalent examination marks/year which you have completed or for which you have the complete result in hand by the last date of online submission of admission application. Q7. What to do, if I am unable to register on Admission Web Portal? or email address is already registered? Or User Name and Password not received via email? A. You have to re-check that either you have already registered with the same email address or CNIC number. If you did not receive the login information, please check Junk or Spam folder in your email. In both cases, please contact on Helpdesk to resolve the issue. Q8. What to do, if I am unable to login to the Admission Portal with the provided User ID and Password? A. Make sure to enter the correct User ID and Password, since the password is case sensitive. Also make sure the difference between “0” (zero) and “O” (O for orange), “L” (L for Leaf) or “I” (I for Ink) which usually cause password error. Q9. What if, I am unable to upload my photograph on the Admission Portal? A. Please make sure that your photograph is according to the instructions provided in “Guideline for the Application Photograph”. Q10. How can I pay Application Fee? A. Following procedure is to be followed for the payment of the application fee: i) After completing Online Application Form, required application fee (including self- finance/sponsor fee, if applicable) shall be indicated on the Transaction Slip, which contains an important number called Transaction ID. ii) Take a Print-out of Transaction Slip and pay the indicated fee at any branch of the banks specified on Transaction Slip. iii) It is very important to note that the payment at the bank should be against the Transaction ID mentioned on the Transaction Slip. Q11. How would I get my Pre-Admission Entry Test ADMIT CARD? A. After confirmation of receipt of fee at the bank, ADMIT CARD will be available in the Online Admission Portal, provided all other requirements (mainly photograph) found suitable. Please note that Admit Card will be not issued if either the fee payment is not confirmed or uploaded photograph is invalid. Q12. What to do after passing Pre-Admission Entry Test? A. You are required to follow the admission schedule and instructions given on it. For updates kindly refer to NED University website: https://www.neduet.edu.pk/admission. Q13. Where Admission Form can be submitted? A. You need to print out the Admission Form along with Annexures (I & II), duly signed from Oath Commissioner and submit with other required documents to Admission Office of the University at the time of interview. Please refer the Document Checklist for further details. Q14. How can I apply for any additional category? A. You can apply against any additional category for which you are eligible during initial submission of online Admission Form, latest by the due date. Note: Eligibility for admission under each category/discipline is as described in Chapter-4 & Chapter-5 of the Undergraduate Prospectus (Soft copy is available at NED University website). Q15. Do I have to pay any fee for Additional category? A. No, there is NO extra fee for additional category(ies) in which you are eligible to apply except Self-Finance category(ies). Q16. What are the requirements of admission in the category of differently able candidate? A. For admission in category for those having disability and passed HSC (Pre- Engineering/Pre-Medical/Computer Science/Arts/Arts-Math/Commerce) part I and II (as the case may be), from any Board of Intermediate of Education situated in province of Sindh and having certificate of disability from Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPD), Government of Sindh. Further the candidate is required to appear before the Medical Board at the University. Q17. What are the admission requirements for the category of religious minorities? A. They must be resident of Pakistan, belong to religious minorities and have passed HSC (Pre-Engineering/ Pre-Medical / Computer Science / Commerce / Arts /Arts-Math) Part I and II from any Board of Intermediate Education or Equivalent foreign examination as recognized by the University can apply for the religious minorities category. Q18. Are DAE holders eligible to apply for the admissions? A. For admission in the category reserved for Diploma of Associate Engineer (DAE), the applicant must pass the qualifying examination from institution recognized by Sindh Board of Technical Education (SBTE), with minimum 60%, during last three years. Applicants who are awaiting the result are not eligible to apply. Entry Test Q1. What are the passing marks in Entry Tests? A. 50% marks in entry test are required to qualify for admission. Q2. When would the Entry test be held? A. Entry Test schedule will be available at www.neduet.edu.pk/admission. Q3. When would Entry Test result be announced? A. Pre-Admission Entry test result will be announced after the last session of the computer- based test and available on NEDUET website. Q4. How many times a candidate may appear in the entry test? A. Pre-Admission Entry test will be held twice. A candidate can appear in both tests. Separate fee for each test is required to pay. Q5. Which Pre-Admission Entry test score will be considered for the admission? A. Between the two results, whichever is higher will be considered for the admission. Q6. How much fee will be charged for the second attempt? A. The test fee for second attempt of entry test will be notified on NED website. Q7. What will be dates for the Pre-Admission Entry Phase-I and Phase-II? A. The test dates for both phases will be notified on NED website. Q8. What type of Pre-Admission Entry Test is taken at NED UET? A. Pre-Admission Entry Test is computer based and comprised of Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) with Four Sections. Each of 25 marks and comprising of the subjects based on applicant’s HSC or Equivalent examinations Group. Following table illustrates the sections of the test. Subjects in HSC/Equivalent Examinations Section in Pre-Admission Entry Test Pre-Engineering Group /DAE (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) Section 1 English Section 2 Mathematics Section 3 Physics Section 4 Chemistry Pre-Medical Group (Biology, Physics, Chemistry) Section 1 English Section 2 Biology Section 3 Physics Section 4 Chemistry Computer Science Group (Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science) Section 1 English Section 2 Mathematics Section 3 Physics Section 4 Computer Science Computer Science Group (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science) Section 1 English Section 2 Mathematics Section 3 Statistics Section 4 Computer Science Commerce Group Section 1 English Section 2 Accounting Section 3 Economics Section 4 Business Mathematics Arts Group Section 1 English 1 Section 2 English 2 Section 3 Basic Mathematics Section 4 General Knowledge Arts (Mathematics) Group Section 1 English 1 Section 2 English 2 Section 3 Mathematics** Section 4 General Knowledge * *Mathematics -- equivalent to the HSC/GCE level Pre-Engineering Group Mathematics course content. Q8. Is there any weightage of entry test marks in merit score? A Yes, the weightage of test score is 60%. Admission Schedule Q1. When will the merit list be displayed? A. Please see “Admission Schedule” available at www.neduet.edu.pk/admission. Q2. What is the admission schedule? A. Admission Schedule is a document with important dates for admissions & related activities. Tuition / Semester Fee Q1. How much is the admission fee? A. Please see Chapter-8 of the Undergraduate Prospectus. Q2. When do I have to pay Self-Finance Fee? A. Self-Finance fee has to be paid latest by the due date of the submission of online application form. For any updates please visit NEDUET website. Q3. How much fees are charged against Self-Finance or Self Sponsor? A. Following are the fees: • Self-Finance Fee Rs. 890,000/- + 3% Tax* • Self-Finance (Sponsored Seats) Fee Rs. 1,100,000/- + 3% Tax* • Foreign Student Fee Rs. 1,100,000/- + 3% Tax* *as per the directive of Sindh Board of Revenue Q4. What if I will get admission in Regular scheme, would the self-finance amount be refunded? A. Yes, when you opt for admission in Regular Seat, total self-finance fee will be refunded. For refund you have to submit self-finance refund form (available at website) with all relevant documents as required. Q5. Does Self-finance fee include admission fee? A. No, it does not. Self-finance fee is to be paid once only at the time of admission form submission. You must have to pay admission fee at the time of admission in addition to the Self-Finance fee. Admission Requirements Q1. What documents are required during Medical Fitness Test? A. You are required to bring Admission form along with all the documents mentioned in the document’s checklist. Q2. Do I have to bring any other document on the Admission Day? A. No, you are required to bring Admission fee along with the required documents only. Q3. Can I pay the admission fee after taking the admission? A. No, your admission will not be confirmed until the admission fee is paid on the day of interview/admission. The admission fee may in the form of Cash or Pay order/Demand draft in favor of Director Finance, NEDUET. Q4. Can anyone having HSC or Equivalent examinations Pre-Medical, apply for only Bio- Engineering programme? A. Please refer to Chapter 4 and Chapter 5 of current Undergraduate Prospectus. Q5. Can anyone having passed HSC or Equivalent examinations Commerce examination apply for admission? A. Yes, please refer to Chapter 4 and Chapter 5 of current Undergraduate Prospectus. Q6. Can anyone having passed HSC or Equivalent examinations (Science General/Computer Science) examination with Physics, Mathematics and Computer Science eligible for admission? A. Yes, please refer to Chapter 4 and Chapter 5 of current Undergraduate Prospectus. Miscellaneous Q1. Where Bachelor of Architecture and BS Development Studies classes are held? A. Classes of Bachelor of Architecture and BS Development Studies are held at City Campus which is adjacent to Govt. DJ Science College. Classes for Bio-Medical Engineering are held at LEJ Campus situated opposite to Liaquat National Hospital. Q2. Is there any Shuttle Bus Service available for City Campus and LEJ Campus? A. No, there is no specific bus service for these campuses. However, some of the shuttle buses pass in front of these campuses. Details will be provided on the day of orientation. Q3. What is the duration of degree programmes offered by the University? A. All programmes are of Four years duration except Bachelors in Architecture which is of Five years duration. pages.content: The University provides residential accommodation for outstation students through Muhammad Bin Qasim (MBQ) Hostel, located adjacent to the main campus. This facility consists of two separate blocks for boys i.e. MBQ-I and MBQ-II, and a dedicated Girls Hostel. The hostels are equipped with essential amenities including a Common Room, Prayer Hall, Warden’s Office, and Warden’s Room. Accommodation is primarily reserved for students who are non-residents of Karachi and is allocated through a Hostel Allotment Committee appointed by the Vice-Chancellor. The university provides separate hostels for male and female students. Details of accommodation are presented below: Hostel Type of Room No. of Rooms Room Size Capacity MBQ–I Cubicle 16 12’-0” × 8’-6” = 102 sq. ft. 16 students Dormitory 34 18’-6” × 11’-0” = 203 sq. ft. MBQ–II Cubicle 48 12’-0” × 8’-6” = 102 sq. ft. 48 students Dormitory 72 18’-6” × 11’-0” = 203 sq. ft. Girls Hostel Dormitory 20 12’-0” × 16’-0” = 192 sq. ft. 41 students Facilities and Services : The hostels are equipped with essential amenities to ensure student comfort and convenience. Each hostel includes a Common Room, Prayer Hall, Warden’s Office, and Canteen facilities. Additional services include: Wi-Fi connectivity throughout the hostel premises. Washing and laundry services for resident students. Canteen service providing hygienic meals and refreshments. Hostel Management Information System (HMIS) for computerized record keeping. Allotment Process : The hostel allotment process is transparent and merit-based. Students admitted from boards other than Karachi are eligible for hostel accommodation, which is provided on a first come first served basis. Applications are invited from newly admitted first-year students in the month of November after the completion of the admission process, and a merit list is maintained. Initially, first year students are allotted spaces in the hostel halls, and as rooms become available, they are shifted according to their merit. Due to the shortage of rooms, dormitories currently accommodate three students each, while cubicle rooms are reserved for final-year students. Although boarding (mess) facilities are not provided by the University, a canteen service is available within the hostel premises offering daily meals and refreshments. Additionally, residents are provided with Wi-Fi connectivity, enabling access to online academic resources, and a washing and laundry facility is available for the convenience of students. All hostel records are fully computerized using the Hostel Management Information System (HMIS), ensuring efficient record-keeping and operational transparency. Hostel charges are collected in advance on a semester basis. ​ Figure 1: View of Muhammad Bin Qasim Hostel boys and Girls Hostel, highlighting spacious design and maintained surroundings.
